title: Subject-specific knee joint geometry improves predictions of medial tibiofemoral contact forces

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Subject-specific knee joint geometry improves predictions of medial tibiofemoral contact forces》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】This study aimed to investigate the influence of subject-specific geometry and knee joint kinematics on the prediction of tibiofemoral contact forces using a calibrated EMG-driven neuromusculoskeletal model of the knee.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Subject-specific knee joint geometry improves predictions of medial tibiofemoral contact forces》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】The use of subject-specific models with minimization of the peak tibiofemoral contact forces improved the accuracy of medial contact forces by 47% and lateral contact forces by 7%, respectively compared with the use of generic musculoskeletal model.
